sources.entry: Mediawiki - Wiki software package that powers Wikipedia and all other Wikimedia projects, serving hundreds of millions of users each month. (Demo, Source Code) GPL-2.0 PHP

summary.name: MediaWiki
summary.one_liner: MediaWiki is a free, open-source wiki software package for collaboration and documentation, and it powers Wikipedia and other Wikimedia projects.
use_cases: Run a public or internal wiki for collecting and organising knowledge
Host a company or organisation knowledge base
Extend a wiki with plugins for custom functionality
Find hosting or consultants for a wiki deployment
summary.what_it_does: MediaWiki is wiki software used by tens of thousands of websites and thousands of organisations, and it is the software behind Wikipedia. The page describes it as powerful, multilingual, customisable, and extensible, with functionality added through extensions. Users can download, install and configure it, or find hosting services if they do not run their own server. The project provides developer documentation and the Wikimedia Developer Portal for those who want to extend the code. The page also lists community channels for support, translation, and bug or feature reports, plus release announcements and events.
notable: Powers Wikipedia and all other Wikimedia projects
Extensible through a large set of installable extensions
caveats: Self-hosting requires a server; hosting services are needed if you do not own one
Advanced customisation or deployment may require professional consulting or development help
